title: Half-term hifdh check: Al-Qiyamah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 37. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (١) وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ (٢) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ (٣) بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ (٤) بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ (٥) يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (٦) فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ (٧) وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ (٨) وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ (٩) يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ (١٠)

فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ (٣١) وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ (٣٢) ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ (٣٣) أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ (٣٤) ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ (٣٥) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى (٣٦) أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ (٣٧) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ (٣٨) فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ (٣٩) أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ (٤٠)

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of Al-Qiyamah 75:1-40 in register order.
questions.a: 75:1-40 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Recital rota: today's group recites Al-Qiyamah 75:1-40 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest section and log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your target in the portal response box. Start: 'In my next recital I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'In my next recital I will make the saktah in 75:27 without a breath.'
A) Munfasil. Alif ends لَآ; the hamza starts أُقْسِمُ.
work on my one target daily
options: work on my one target daily

questions.q: Think again: What has helped your hifdh most this half term?
questions.a: Answers vary: listening first (75:18), sections, daily logging.
